mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA JOIN SMT_DEVICE device ON SDA.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE NVL(SDA.STATUS, 0) = 0 AND SDA.ACTION IN (2, 12) AND SDA.OVER_TIME <= #{currentTime} AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) AND device.CONNECT_STATUS = 2 ORDER BY SDA.CREATE_TIME ASC, SDA.TIMES ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA JOIN SMT_DEVICE device ON SDA.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE NVL(SDA.STATUS, 0) = 0 AND SDA.ACTION IN (1, 3, 11, 13) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND SDA.OVER_TIME > #{currentTime} AND SDA.START_TIME < #{currentTime} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) AND device.CONNECT_STATUS = 2 ORDER BY SDA.START_TIME ASC, SDA.TIMES ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1000

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA JOIN SMT_DEVICE device ON SDA.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE NVL(SDA.STATUS, 0) = 0 AND SDA.ACTION IN (1, 3, 11, 13) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND SDA.OVER_TIME <= #{currentTime} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 AND device.CONNECT_STATUS = 2 ORDER BY SDA.OVER_TIME ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , SDA.APPLY_ID, device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE device ON SDA.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE (SDA.STATUS IN (0, 3, 6) OR SDA.STATUS IS NULL) AND SDA.ACTION IN (1, 3, 11, 13) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND (SDA.CODE != 200 OR SDA.CODE IS NULL) AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) AND SDA.CREATE_TIME <= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 0 - #{staleMonths}) AND (device.ID IS NULL OR device.CONNECT_STATUS IS NULL OR device.CONNECT_STATUS != 2) ORDER BY SDA.CREATE_TIME ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500

UPDATE SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA SET SDA.STATUS = #{status}, SDA.CODE = #{code}, SDA.REMARK = #{remark}, SDA.UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime}, SDA.OPT_USER = #{optUser} WHERE SDA.ID = #{id} AND (SDA.STATUS IN (0, 3, 6) OR SDA.STATUS IS NULL) AND SDA.ACTION IN (1, 3, 11, 13) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND (SDA.CODE != 200 OR SDA.CODE IS NULL) AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) AND SDA.CREATE_TIME <= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 0 - #{staleMonths}) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_DEVICE device WHERE device.ID = SDA.DEVICE_CODE ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_DEVICE device WHERE device.ID = SDA.DEVICE_CODE AND (device.CONNECT_STATUS IS NULL OR device.CONNECT_STATUS != 2) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT ,device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA join SMT_DEVICE device on sda.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE (SDA.STATUS = 0 or SDA.STATUS is null) AND SDA.OVER_TIME > #{overTime} AND SDA.START_TIME < #{overTime} AND (SDA.ACTION = 1 or SDA.ACTION = 3) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND (SDA.CODE != 200 or SDA.CODE is null) AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) and device.CONNECT_STATUS = 2 ORDER BY SDA.START_TIME ASC, SDA.TIMES ASC

SELECT , device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA JOIN SMT_DEVICE device ON SDA.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE (SDA.STATUS IN (0, 6) OR SDA.STATUS IS NULL) AND (SDA.ACTION = 1 or SDA.ACTION = 3) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND SDA.OVER_TIME > #{overTime} AND (SDA.START_TIME IS NULL OR SDA.START_TIME < #{overTime}) AND (SDA.CODE != 200 OR SDA.CODE IS NULL) AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) AND device.CONNECT_STATUS = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN SDA.START_TIME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, SDA.START_TIME ASC, SDA.TIMES ASC

SELECT ,device.park_id FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SDA join SMT_DEVICE device on SDA.DEVICE_CODE = device.ID WHERE SDA.OVER_TIME > #{overTime} AND SDA.START_TIME < #{overTime} AND SDA.START_TIME > (#{overTime} - 2 * 24 * 60 * 60) AND (SDA.ACTION = 1 or SDA.ACTION = 3 or SDA.ACTION = 11 or SDA.ACTION = 13) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND SDA.CODE in (502,506) AND (SDA.TIMES IS NULL OR SDA.TIMES < 10) and device.CONNECT_STATUS = 2 ORDER BY SDA.START_TIME ASC, SDA.TIMES ASC
